flows.logicalPrerequisiteRule: Explicit driver abort or definite receiver Rejected outcome; each actual source-admission guard/proof must still authorize the abort. Never infer cancellation from missing state.

selectedAdmissionContract.guards: Only before EvidenceArtifactDownloadIssued; prove expired/revoked/conflicting required source or invalid/unavailable ticket outcome. Atomically fence grant issuance before source use settlement, including not-yet-acquired uses. Already issued grant cannot renew or change result; release uses from its exact issued fact.

expectedRevisionScope.counter: No primary caller ResourceRevision. Enforce required authored source/epoch/version tokens, immutable creation identity or trusted proof/generation as declared; append uses physical OCC.

verification.admission: AdmissionReference is a locator only. Resolve and independently verify actual typed admitted fact, exact owner/tenant/program, saved metadata and physical/hydrated cut, original root/episode/actor/intent and immutable content.
verification.stageAndTerminal: Materialize each required typed stage/terminal proof from actual committed facts and full required immutable selections; prove complete grant/fence/provisional/child sets, not counts/checkpoints. Guard sets are not weakened by carrier choice.
verification.earlyReplay: If native receipt binding does not cover a supplied/interpreted command term, bind that term through the required actual typed proof/body before early replay. Exact receipt cannot bypass proof manifest or source tuple guards.
verification.resultAndRecovery: Current public authorization precedes replay. Original result/receipt and unknown-append recovery stay exact; requested cancellation propagates. Unavailable proof/content remains transient; corruption/changed intent is permanent; no inferred absence/release.
verification.implementationStatus: Installed pointer/handler/process presence is not proof of conformance. Field/wire migration and required behavioral tests remain separately verifiable implementation work.

requiredProofContract.artifactAbortAuthority: Actual provable pre-issue expiry/revocation/conflict/terminal failure bound to accepted root and complete held/not-yet-held key set; no cancellation from unavailable body alone. Atomically fence receiving issue before any settlement. Already issued recovers forward.

flows.recoveryContract: Exact source/generation fence before source-use release, including not-yet-acquired keys where selected. Published/irreversible outcomes recover forward; unknown append/unavailable remains transient; no unproven absence or clear-all release.

atomicLocalAvailabilityRole.authority: The single committed EvidenceArtifactDownloadRequested fact simultaneously records admission and installs its exact local availability reservation/fence.
atomicLocalAvailabilityRole.predicate: Pin this artifact-owned available inspected content/head and exact generation for this admitted root through actual receiving issue or cancellation. Any artifact-owned mutation that would invalidate it must honor the reservation.
atomicLocalAvailabilityRole.identity: Exact first-owner artifact + root CommandId + receiving derived grant + purpose/generation; no global command uniqueness assumption.
atomicLocalAvailabilityRole.proofTiming: Before append, only prove actual already-saved predecessor/content sources. Never construct a proof of the future Requested fact. After append, derive and verify actual saved Requested source/metadata and local reservation authority; that fact proves the availability grant for foreign issue.
atomicLocalAvailabilityRole.bounds: Retain every active reservation legitimately needed for current authority; no arbitrary cap. Closed history/fences may be externalized only with verified immutable exact-cut authority.
atomicLocalAvailabilityRole.externalBoundary: This local hold does not claim an atomic transaction with foreign owners or physical content storage. Issue still proves actual stored content/URI and bounded lifetime; unavailable dependencies remain transient. No invented cross-owner permit or absence proof.

requiredProofContract.originalResponse: Freeze the exact standard 202 OperationAcceptedResponse(CommandId, artifact-scoped status URL, original AcceptedAt) on first acceptance. Later receiving issuance never replaces or reconstructs that root first response.
requiredProofContract.replayAndFailure: Current public authorization first; exact native original202 returns only for fully bound original intent/actor. Equal winner and unknown append recover actual committed acceptance; requested cancellation passes through. Availability/source conflict or corruption does not silently become cancellation without the selected proof.
